hints.title: Most Significant Digit Flip
hints.text: To maximize the resulting value, flip the highest place value digit 6 into a 9.

hints.title: Single Replacement
hints.text: Only a single digit change is allowed. The leftmost occurrence of 6 gives the maximum increase.

hints.title: String Replacement
hints.text: Convert num to string, replace the first occurrence of "6" with "9", and convert back to integer.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: D: number of digits in num (at most 4)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Flipping lower place-value digits before higher ones produces suboptimal increases.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Replacing the first 6 left-to-right runs in O(D) time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate applies greedy priority on highest place value digits.
complexity.notes: Can also be solved with pure integer arithmetic using place values.
